zh.cat-outpost-purpose: 以貓咪同最後補給站做主題，將部署、資源分配同生存挑戰放入一個瀏覽器塔防遊戲。

zh.cat-outpost-features1: 點選炮塔升級或換裝，喺戰況變化時調整防線。
zh.cat-outpost-features2: 支援暫停、震盪脈衝，同手機點格後確認部署。
zh.cat-outpost-build0: 遊戲喺瀏覽器本機運行。公開部署包含 HTML 入口、JavaScript 同 CSS 資源，透過 GitHub Pages 發布。
zh.cat-outpost-build1: 最高生存紀錄同音效設定保存在瀏覽器本機，毋須登入。介面提供選塔、部署、升級同換裝嘅操作流程。

zh.cat-outpost-proof2: 本機紀錄依賴瀏覽器儲存；清除網站資料或轉用其他裝置，紀錄唔會自動同步。
zh.stock-atlas-lede: 查股票術語，再用港股或美股代號研究一隻股票。
zh.stock-atlas-description: 200 個術語、八大分類，再用港股或美股代號研究走勢同基本面。
zh.stock-atlas-purpose: 將股票術語嘅白話解釋同市場研究放喺同一個網站，先理解概念，再睇一隻股票嘅數據。
zh.stock-atlas-features0: 搜尋 200 個術語，按八大分類或程度篩選，查看例子、公式及相關概念。
zh.stock-atlas-features1: 收藏術語，重新開啟後喺同一個瀏覽器繼續閱讀。
zh.stock-atlas-features2: 輸入港股或美股代號，查看價格走勢、技術指標、年度財務及有說明嘅觀察分。
zh.stock-atlas-build0: 原生 JavaScript 前端部署於 GitHub Pages，負責路由、搜尋、收藏同資料呈現。Cloudflare Worker 處理公開市場資料請求及年度財務資料。
zh.stock-atlas-build1: 分析程式包含技術指標同評分規則。缺漏數據保留缺漏狀態；資料來源、日期同覆蓋率一齊呈現，唔用示範報價代替真實回應。
zh.stock-atlas-proof0: 1.1.0 於 2026-10-31 通過 200 個術語驗證及 22 項測試；正式網站四單元路線、700 與 AAPL 真實價格及年度財報、幣種顯示及術語返回期間已核對。實體手機及真人試用未完成。
zh.stock-atlas-proof1: 行情來源係 Yahoo Finance 公開介面，可能延遲、限流或改動。第一版只分析股票；資料同評分用作理解及研究參考。
zh.stock-atlas-proof2: 收藏儲存在本機，冇跨裝置同步。缺乏可靠數據嘅指標會顯示未提供，唔自行補出數值。

zh.labWaveIntro: 調整振幅同頻率，比較波長。呢個模型嘅波速固定為 1 m/s。
zh.labGravityIntro: 設定初速度同角度，再比較地球、月球同火星嘅落點。
zh.labOpticsIntro: 光線經過兩種介質嘅交界時會改變方向。試下由玻璃射向空氣。
zh.labExportError: 未能下載；參數已保留，可以重試。
zh.labSaved: 參數只保存在呢個瀏覽器。
zh.labUnsaved: 未能保存；仍可操作及下載。
zh.labRecovered: 保存資料無效，已回復預設參數。
zh.labWaveFormula: λ = c / f　·　y = A sin[2π(x / λ − ft)]
zh.labGravityFormula: x = v₀ cosθ · t　·　y = v₀ sinθ · t − ½gt²
zh.labWaveLimit: 理想行波模型；不包含阻尼、反射或繩索張力變化。
zh.labGravityLimit: 由地面發射並落回同一高度；忽略空氣阻力、風力及天體曲率。
zh.labOpticsLimit: 均勻介質、平面交界；折射率採固定近似值，不模擬色散或光強。
zh.labNoJS: 啟用 JavaScript 可以調整參數及播放動畫。以下三個預設示意、公式同模型說明仍可閱讀。
zh.labPrivacy: 所有計算都在本機進行。參數不會上傳。
zh.labCanvasWave: 理想行波圖：橫軸為距離，縱軸為位移
zh.labCanvasGravity: 拋體軌跡圖：橫軸為水平距離，縱軸為高度
zh.labCanvasOptics: 入射、反射及折射光線示意
zh.labTotalNote: 入射角超過臨界角，沒有透射光線。
zh.labDefaultOptics: 預設：空氣進入玻璃、入射角 40°；折射角約 25.37°。

en.cloud-drive-lede: Find notes by subject. Read a PDF or edit a Word file.
en.cloud-drive-description: Find history, physics and English notes by subject. Open a PDF or Word file.
en.cloud-drive-purpose: Bring study files into one browsable place, so you can choose a subject and then a format.
en.cloud-drive-features0: Browse modern Chinese history, Year 9 physics and bilingual English resources.
en.cloud-drive-features1: Choose PDF for reading or Word when you want an editable format.
en.cloud-drive-features2: Open the study folder or a specific document directly from the portfolio.
en.cloud-drive-build0: AList provides the file-browsing interface for documents on Google Drive. The focus is clear subjects, descriptive file names and direct access.
en.cloud-drive-build1: The portfolio keeps a screenshot of the actual file list and links to the original site. This static preview does not fetch live drive content.
en.cloud-drive-proof0: All six PDF/Word documents were read and their contents/formats checked on 2026-10-31. The original links are retained; AList settings, permissions and source documents are unchanged.
en.cloud-drive-proof1: Storage, access permissions and document previews are managed by the original platforms. This project uses existing services rather than a custom cloud-storage platform.
en.cloud-drive-proof2: Direct links may need updating if the site or files move. The screenshot does not indicate live availability.
en.cat-outpost-lede: Deploy and upgrade towers. Defend the cats’ last outpost.
en.cat-outpost-description: Deploy and upgrade towers. Defend your cat outpost against enemies from every direction.
en.cat-outpost-purpose: A browser tower-defence game about cats defending their last supply outpost, combining deployment, resource choices and survival.
en.cat-outpost-features0: Select a tower and an empty tile to defend the area around your base.
en.cat-outpost-features1: Select towers to upgrade or modify them as the battle develops.
en.cat-outpost-features2: Pause the game, trigger a shock pulse, or confirm tile deployment on mobile.
en.cat-outpost-build0: The game runs locally in the browser. Its public deployment includes an HTML entry point, JavaScript and CSS assets, served through GitHub Pages.
en.cat-outpost-build1: Best survival records and sound settings are saved in the local browser without a login. The interface supports selecting, deploying, upgrading and modifying towers.
en.cat-outpost-proof0: On 2026-10-31, version 1.4.0 passed 45 rule/tutorial tests. The live site was checked for successful deployment advancing the tutorial, management access and offline play from the downloaded build. Physical-phone and user trials are pending.
en.cat-outpost-proof1: The public repository primarily contains deployment files. Undisclosed source architecture, algorithms and development processes are not inferred.
en.cat-outpost-proof2: Local records depend on browser storage. Clearing site data or switching devices does not synchronise those records.
en.stock-atlas-lede: Look up stock terms, then research a Hong Kong or US stock.
en.stock-atlas-description: Explore 200 terms in eight categories, then research Hong Kong and US stock trends and fundamentals.
en.stock-atlas-purpose: Connect plain-language stock terminology with market research: understand a concept, then explore a stock’s data.
en.stock-atlas-features0: Search 200 terms, filter by eight categories or level, and explore examples, formulas and related concepts.
en.stock-atlas-features1: Save terms and return to them in the same browser.
en.stock-atlas-features2: Enter a Hong Kong or US stock symbol to view price trends, technical indicators, annual financials and an explained observation score.
en.stock-atlas-build0: A vanilla JavaScript frontend on GitHub Pages handles routing, search, favourites and presentation. A Cloudflare Worker handles public market-data requests and annual financial information.
en.stock-atlas-build1: The analysis code contains technical indicators and scoring rules. Missing values remain missing, with sources, dates and coverage shown rather than substituting example prices.
en.stock-atlas-proof0: On 2026-10-31, version 1.1.0 passed validation of 200 terms and 22 tests. Live checks covered the four-unit route, real quotes and annual financials for 700 and AAPL, currency labels and returning from terms with the chart range preserved. Physical-phone and user trials are pending.
en.stock-atlas-proof1: Data comes from Yahoo Finance’s public interfaces and may be delayed, rate-limited or changed. The first version analyses stocks only; its data and scores support learning and research.
en.stock-atlas-proof2: Favourites are local and do not sync across devices. Indicators without reliable data are shown as unavailable rather than filled with invented values.

en.labWaveTask: Double frequency from 0.5 Hz to 1 Hz: at a fixed wave speed of 1 m/s, wavelength halves from 2 m to 1 m. Does changing amplitude affect wavelength?
en.labGravityTask: At 15 m/s and 45°, compare Earth and Moon. On Earth the equal-height range is about 22.94 m. Ignoring air resistance, how do flight time and range change as gravity falls?
en.labOpticsTask: From glass (1.5) into air (1.0), compare 41° and 42°. The critical angle is about 41.81°; above it, total internal reflection occurs. What happens in the reverse direction?

title: 學習資料
Study resources
lede: 按科目搵溫習資料，揀 PDF 閱讀或 Word 編輯。
Find notes by subject. Read a PDF or edit a Word file.
description: 歷史、物理、英文，按科目搵資料，選 PDF 或 Word 開啟。
Find history, physics and English notes by subject. Open a PDF or Word file.

purpose: 將散落嘅溫習文件集中成一個可以直接瀏覽嘅入口，方便先揀科目，再揀格式。
Bring study files into one browsable place, so you can choose a subject and then a format.
features: 瀏覽中國近代史、初三物理及英文中英對照資料。
Browse modern Chinese history, Year 9 physics and bilingual English resources.
同一科目提供 PDF 同 Word，按閱讀或編輯需要選擇。
Choose PDF for reading or Word when you want an editable format.
由作品集直接進入學習資料夾，或開啟指定文件。
Open the study folder or a specific document directly from the portfolio.
build: 使用 AList 作文件瀏覽介面，連接 Google Drive 嘅文件。整理重點係科目分類、清楚檔名同直接入口。
AList provides the file-browsing interface for documents on Google Drive. The focus is clear subjects, descriptive file names and direct access.
作品集保存實際文件列表截圖，並提供原網站連結；預覽係靜態圖片，唔會即時讀取雲盤內容。
The portfolio keeps a screenshot of the actual file list and links to the original site. This static preview does not fetch live drive content.
proof: 文件列表截圖擷取於 2026-10-25，收錄三科各一份 PDF 及 Word。下方六個入口保留原有公開檔名。
The file-list screenshot was captured on 2026-10-25. It shows one PDF and one Word file for each of three subjects. The six links below retain the original public file names.
檔案儲存、存取權限同文件預覽由原平台管理；呢件作品使用現成平台，唔代表自行開發雲端儲存服務。
Storage, access permissions and document previews are managed by the original platforms. This project uses existing services rather than a custom cloud-storage platform.
原網站或檔案移動時，直接連結可能需要更新；截圖唔代表即時可用狀態。
Direct links may need updating if the site or files move. The screenshot does not indicate live availability.

title: 喵哨站
Cat Outpost
lede: 部署炮塔、改裝升級，守住貓咪最後嘅補給站。
Deploy and upgrade towers. Defend the cats’ last outpost.
description: 部署炮塔、改裝升級，帶領貓咪小隊守住四方來襲嘅敵人。
Deploy and upgrade towers. Defend your cat outpost against enemies from every direction.

purpose: 以貓咪同最後補給站做主題，將部署、資源分配同生存挑戰放入一個瀏覽器塔防遊戲。
A browser tower-defence game about cats defending their last supply outpost, combining deployment, resource choices and survival.
features: 選炮塔、揀空格部署，守住基地四周。
Select a tower and an empty tile to defend the area around your base.
點選炮塔升級或換裝，喺戰況變化時調整防線。
Select towers to upgrade or modify them as the battle develops.
支援暫停、震盪脈衝，同手機點格後確認部署。
Pause the game, trigger a shock pulse, or confirm tile deployment on mobile.
build: 遊戲喺瀏覽器本機運行。公開部署包含 HTML 入口、JavaScript 同 CSS 資源，透過 GitHub Pages 發布。
The game runs locally in the browser. Its public deployment includes an HTML entry point, JavaScript and CSS assets, served through GitHub Pages.
最高生存紀錄同音效設定保存在瀏覽器本機，毋須登入。介面提供選塔、部署、升級同換裝嘅操作流程。
Best survival records and sound settings are saved in the local browser without a login. The interface supports selecting, deploying, upgrading and modifying towers.
可略過嘅首局教學帶你部署、升級同使用脈衝；管理、手動、教學及分頁暫停分開處理。
A skippable tutorial guides deployment, upgrades and pulse use. Management, manual, tutorial and hidden-tab pauses are independent.
proof: 1.4.0 於 2026-10-31 通過 45 項規則及教學測試；正式網站已核對成功部署推進教學、管理入口及下載版離線遊玩。實體手機及真人試用未完成。

On 2026-10-31, version 1.4.0 passed 45 rule/tutorial tests. The live site was checked for successful deployment advancing the tutorial, management access and offline play from the downloaded build. Physical-phone and user trials are pending.
公開儲存庫主要存放正式部署檔案，未公開嘅原始架構、演算法同開發流程不作推測。
The public repository primarily contains deployment files. Undisclosed source architecture, algorithms and development processes are not inferred.
本機紀錄依賴瀏覽器儲存；清除網站資料或轉用其他裝置，紀錄唔會自動同步。
Local records depend on browser storage. Clearing site data or switching devices does not synchronise those records.

title: Stock Atlas
Stock Atlas
lede: 查股票術語，再用港股或美股代號研究一隻股票。
Look up stock terms, then research a Hong Kong or US stock.
description: 200 個術語、八大分類，再用港股或美股代號研究走勢同基本面。
Explore 200 terms in eight categories, then research Hong Kong and US stock trends and fundamentals.

purpose: 將股票術語嘅白話解釋同市場研究放喺同一個網站，先理解概念，再睇一隻股票嘅數據。
Connect plain-language stock terminology with market research: understand a concept, then explore a stock’s data.
features: 搜尋 200 個術語，按八大分類或程度篩選，查看例子、公式及相關概念。
Search 200 terms, filter by eight categories or level, and explore examples, formulas and related concepts.
收藏術語，重新開啟後喺同一個瀏覽器繼續閱讀。
Save terms and return to them in the same browser.
輸入港股或美股代號，查看價格走勢、技術指標、年度財務及有說明嘅觀察分。
Enter a Hong Kong or US stock symbol to view price trends, technical indicators, annual financials and an explained observation score.
build: 原生 JavaScript 前端部署於 GitHub Pages，負責路由、搜尋、收藏同資料呈現。Cloudflare Worker 處理公開市場資料請求及年度財務資料。
A vanilla JavaScript frontend on GitHub Pages handles routing, search, favourites and presentation. A Cloudflare Worker handles public market-data requests and annual financial information.
分析程式包含技術指標同評分規則。缺漏數據保留缺漏狀態；資料來源、日期同覆蓋率一齊呈現，唔用示範報價代替真實回應。
The analysis code contains technical indicators and scoring rules. Missing values remain missing, with sources, dates and coverage shown rather than substituting example prices.
四個學習單元引用既有術語；本機進度同收藏分開保存。股票請求有逾時、取消及舊回應保護。
Four learning units reference existing terms. Local progress is separate from favourites. Stock requests handle timeouts, cancellation and stale responses.
proof: 1.1.0 於 2026-10-31 通過 200 個術語驗證及 22 項測試；正式網站四單元路線、700 與 AAPL 真實價格及年度財報、幣種顯示及術語返回期間已核對。實體手機及真人試用未完成。

On 2026-10-31, version 1.1.0 passed validation of 200 terms and 22 tests. Live checks covered the four-unit route, real quotes and annual financials for 700 and AAPL, currency labels and returning from terms with the chart range preserved. Physical-phone and user trials are pending.
行情來源係 Yahoo Finance 公開介面，可能延遲、限流或改動。第一版只分析股票；資料同評分用作理解及研究參考。
Data comes from Yahoo Finance’s public interfaces and may be delayed, rate-limited or changed. The first version analyses stocks only; its data and scores support learning and research.
收藏儲存在本機，冇跨裝置同步。缺乏可靠數據嘅指標會顯示未提供，唔自行補出數值。
Favourites are local and do not sync across devices. Indicators without reliable data are shown as unavailable rather than filled with invented values.
